description_en: Queries the status information of an asynchronous task. After you call an asynchronous operation, an asynchronous task is generated. You can call the GetJobStatus operation to query the status of the asynchronous task
description_zh: 返回异步任务的状态信息，调用异步化API后，通过轮训此API来获取成功状态
name: GetJobStatus

parameters.help_en: The ID of the asynchronous task that is generated after you call an asynchronous operation
parameters.help_zh: 调用异步API后返回的任务ID
parameters.name: job_id
